ATL.name: Jock Landale
ATL.detail: Landale (hip) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.

ATL.name: Asa Newell
ATL.detail: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: CJ McCollum
ATL.detail: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

ATL.name: Mouhamed Gueye
ATL.detail: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Henri Veesaar
ATL.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

DAL.name: Caleb Martin
DAL.detail: Martin didn't return for the second half of Friday's win over the Suns due to a left ankle sprain, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

DAL.name: Kyrie Irving
DAL.detail: Irving (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Suns, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.

DAL.name: Tobi Lawal
DAL.detail: Lawal (groin) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

DAL.name: Sergio de Larrea
DAL.detail: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

DAL.name: Dereck Lively II
DAL.detail: Lively (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

DAL.name: Tarik Biberovic
DAL.detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

DET.name: Duncan Robinson
DET.detail: Robinson (quadriceps) is out for Friday's game against the Bucks.

DET.name: Cade Cunningham
DET.detail: Cunningham (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Bucks.

DET.name: Jalen Duren
DET.detail: Detroit recalled Duren (hamstring) from the G League's Motor City Cruise on Wednesday.

DET.name: Ebuka Okorie
DET.detail: The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks, per Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com.

DET.name: Taurean Prince
DET.detail: Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

GS.name: Gui Santos
GS.detail: Santos exited Friday's game against the Trail Blazers with a knee injury in the second half and won't return.

GS.name: Stephen Curry
GS.detail: Curry (abdomen/oblique) has been ruled out for each of the Warriors' next three games, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports

GS.name: Kristaps Porzingis
GS.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

GS.name: Moses Moody
GS.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Jimmy Butler III
GS.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

LAC.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
LAC.detail: Niederhauser suffered a right toe injury during Friday's game against the Pelicans and won't return, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.

LAC.name: Bradley Beal
LAC.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

LAC.name: Jordan Miller
LAC.detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

MIN.name: LaMelo Ball
MIN.detail: Ball (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies. The guard was previously questionable after spraining his left ankle during Wednesday's win over Oklahoma City.

MIN.name: Donte DiVincenzo
MIN.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

MIN.name: Jaylen Clark
MIN.detail: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

MIN.name: Anthony Edwards
MIN.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

NO.name: Bennedict Mathurin
NO.detail: Mathurin (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

NO.name: Julian Reese
NO.detail: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.

NO.name: Dejounte Murray
NO.detail: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

NY.name: Miles McBride
NY.detail: McBride (groin) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

NY.name: OG Anunoby
NY.detail: Anunoby (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Heat. The forward was previously listed as doubtful and will miss his third consecutive contest due to a left calf strain.

NY.name: Jordan Clarkson
NY.detail: Clarkson (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

NY.name: Andre Drummond
NY.detail: Drummond (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Heat.

POR.name: Damian Lillard
POR.detail: Lillard (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors. The veteran guard is dealing with right calf tightness and soreness.

POR.name: Chris Youngblood
POR.detail: Youngblood (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

POR.name: Vit Krejci
POR.detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

POR.name: Ja Morant
POR.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

POR.name: Shaedon Sharpe
POR.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

SAC.name: Zach LaVine
SAC.detail: LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.

SAC.name: Maxime Raynaud
SAC.detail: Raynaud (knee) was recalled from the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

SAC.name: Ben Simmons
SAC.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

TOR.name: Ja'Kobe Walter
TOR.detail: Walter won't return to Friday's game against Brooklyn due to a right quad contusion, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

TOR.name: Kawhi Leonard
TOR.detail: Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts following treatment to address swelling in his left knee, and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

TOR.name: Nate Bittle
TOR.detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

TOR.name: RJ Barrett
TOR.detail: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
